objective: Review the status/readiness hardening definition for the non-executing native-parser adapter-payload to sidecar plan-resolution fixture and accept only the readiness-classified outer status contract before any sidecar handoff contract, command synthesis, execution, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary RTL/filelist support, automatic allocation, upstream regression success, or upstream landing claim.

review_decision.reason: The definition targets the actual bug risk: an outer plan-resolution status of planned can hide nested unsupported or not-ready sidecar_stage_plan results. The selected contract classifies the outer status as direct Verilator option readiness while preserving nested stage_plan_status, which is the smallest useful boundary before implementation.
review_decision.weakest_point: The term ready_for_verilator_option_shim can still be over-read as native Verilator execution support if callers ignore the readiness-only non-claims. The implementation must therefore expose an explicit plan_resolution_readiness object, preserve stage_plan_status, and keep execution, command synthesis, sidecar_handoff_contract, timing, runtime/ABI, arbitrary filelist support, and automatic allocation absent.

required_next_implementation.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_sidecar_plan_resolution_status_hardening_gate
must_implement: derive outer status from sidecar_stage_plan status plus nested verilator_option_readiness status
set outer status ready_for_verilator_option_shim only for stage_plan.status planned with nested readiness ready_for_verilator_option_shim
set outer status not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim for stage_plan.status planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim
set outer status unsupported_for_stage_plan for stage_plan.status unsupported_for_stage_plan
preserve stage_plan_status separately from outer status
add plan_resolution_readiness with stage_plan_status, verilator_option_readiness_status, ready_for_direct_verilator_option, not_ready_reason, and status_source
keep sidecar_handoff_contract, command synthesis, operator plan, execution, measurement, runtime/ABI change, source closure inference, filelist expansion, and automatic allocation absent
must_test: template mode returns outer status ready_for_verilator_option_shim and ready_for_direct_verilator_option true
resident-state-reuse returns outer status not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim while preserving stage_plan_status planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim
persistent-resident-state-abi returns outer status not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim while preserving stage_plan_status planned_not_ready_for_verilator_option_shim
unsupported mode returns outer status unsupported_for_stage_plan and ready_for_direct_verilator_option false
not-ready and unsupported cases do not include sidecar_handoff_contract, operator_plan, verilator_command, verilator_command_argv, execution, measurement, or timing evidence
must_not_do: infer arbitrary source closure or filelist dependencies
claim arbitrary RTL or arbitrary filelist support

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not command synthesis from native parser payload
not coverage-output equivalence for a native-parser flow
not a new public CLI or workflow
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
